user.title: Connect to SensorLinx
user.description: Enter the same email and password you use in the SensorLinx Android app.

building.title: Select building
building.description: Your account has multiple buildings. Choose which one to import into Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the SensorLinx cloud API.
error.no_buildings: No buildings were found on this account.
error.building_not_found: The selected building could not be found.

init.title: External switches
init.description: Link physical Home Assistant switches that power your hot-water heater and radiant-floor controller.

heating_source.title: Floor heating source
heating_source.description: Select the water heater that supplies your radiant floor loops. If the Optimal Tankless integration is installed, it will appear here and all sensors (inlet, outlet, flow rate) will be auto-configured.

zone_valves.title: Zone valve counts
zone_valves.description: Set how many valves are connected to each thermostat zone. This is used to estimate water flow rate and BTU heat output per zone.
